thread: ravi-docs: opening a tiny docs PR to add an end-to-end example for validating cert chains and bundle checksums when installing HSM connectors on edge/private installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2050 ana-engr: nit: please include both Windows and Linux verification commands. customers hit chain/trust issues when intermediates aren't imported in exactly the right order. ravi-docs: yes. plan: short checklist, commands for OpenSSL, PowerShell, and a minimal script for verifying tarball checksums + signature. will also add a quick note about tunneled management (SSH jump) for sealed sites. kevin-sre: include the common error patterns: e.g., "certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate" -> missing intermediate or wrong SAN on cert. Add one-liners to dump the cert chain and verify each link. ravi-docs: adding examples: - Linux: `openssl s_client -connect hsm.internal:15001 -showcerts` then `openssl verify -CAfile ca-bundle.pem cert.pem` - Windows PS: `$c = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2('C:\\hsm\\agent.crt'); $c.Issuer` and `certutil -verify agent.crt` ana-engr: for tunneled installs, show how to forward the socket over SSH for local verification: `ssh -L 15001:127.0.0.1:15001 jumpbox -- sleep 60` then run openssl against localhost. include note about keepalive for long imports. kevin-sre: for airgap bundles, please add SHA256 and GPG verification steps and a tiny script to check both. many partners only run checksum but forget to import vendor signing key. snippet suggestion: ```bash # verify checksum sha256sum -c offline-bundle.sha256 # verify signature gpg --keyring ./trustedkeys.gpg --verify offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig offline-bundle.tar.gz ``` ravi-docs: will include that. also adding recommended folder layout for the installer: `bundle/ checksums/ vendor-key.gpg examples/`. ci-bot: docs linkcheck flagged a cross-link to `docs/private/install#certs` on PR #2050 - broken anchor. ravi-docs: thanks CI. I'll add explicit anchors in the markdown and update any inbound links. planning to add `` above the cert section to be resilient. ana-engr: small UX addition: include a PowerShell snippet to export the certificate chain from a Windows machine (useful for support): `Get-ChildItem Cert:\\LocalMachine\\My\\ | Where-Object { $_.Subject -match 'CN=redwood-hsm' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Export([System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509ContentType]::Cert) }` and then show `certutil -dump` on the exported file. kevin-sre: add a troubleshooting table entry for tunneled installs: symptom "handshake stalls" -> cause "SSH MTU or TCP MSS clamping over path" -> quick fix "enable TCP keepalive and reduce MTU on tunnel endpoints" with example `ssh -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o Tunnel=ethernet`. ravi-docs: good catch. i'll include keepalive + MTU notes and example `ip link set dev tun0 mtu 1400` for constrained networks. ops-bot: CI / docs linkcheck re-run requested on PR #2050. ci-bot: lint: please wrap long code lines in docs. ravi-docs: wrapped, pushed. tagging @ana-engr and @kevin-sre for quick review. once linkcheck clears i'll merge and add the example scripts to `examples/hsm/verify/` in the repo. thanks! :white_check_mark:
